source_status.consumption: synthetic individuals; E-REDES BTN-C prior for domestic shape
source_status.weather: PVGIS SARAH3 historical irradiance, reanalysis temperature/wind; interpolated to 15 min
source_status.carbon: REN 15-min mix, APA annual calibration, REE daily imports: derived operational consumption proxy, not measured emissions
source_status.prices: OMIE + MIBEL + 2023 indexed supply and ERSE BTN/BTE access; pre-VAT variable cost; fixed fees separate

mobility: energy ledger; actual SOC persists across community chargers; explicit outside-community energy; unmet trip energy recorded
battery: explicit constant 94% round-trip curve; 2%/month self-discharge; 8 W standby only while physical battery present; fixed capacity (ageing not calibrated)
scenario_scope: fictional Lisboa REC; asset shares chosen for benchmark diversity, NOT estimated national adoption; v1 and v2 performance not interchangeable
nested_core: First residential core members share latent parameters; not independent validation split
